headline: Turkey Weighs Lowering Deposit Withholding Taxes to Support Lira Demand
summary: According to sources close to the matter, Turkey's Treasury and Finance Ministry is preparing to lower deposit withholding taxes to support demand for the lira following a drop in central bank FX reserves.
why: Tax adjustments on local currency deposits are standard fiscal tools used by emerging market authorities to defend local currency adoption.

impacts.name: Turkish lira
impacts.why: Fiscal incentives designed to increase local currency deposit attractiveness aim to stabilize exchange rates.
